name: indahl-trust-but-verify
description: Quiet is not success. After any action that claims it worked (a push, a deploy, a sync, a job, an import, a migration, a scheduled run), read the effect back from where it should have landed instead of trusting the exit code, an 'ok' line or the absence of errors. Returns VERIFIED, FAILED, NOTHING_RETURNED or CANNOT_TELL per action, and scans scripts for the patterns that hide failures. Nothing is sent outside your session.
